Voodoo Wallet — Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 14, 2026 · Version 1.0.6

Summary: Voodoo Wallet is a non-custodial PulseChain wallet. We do not run servers or collect your data. Keys stay encrypted on your device and are never sent to us.

1. Data stored on your device

The extension stores data locally in Chrome storage:

  • chrome.storage.local — encrypted wallet vault, settings, custom tokens, NFT collections, DApp connection permissions
  • chrome.storage.session — temporary unlocked session (cleared when you lock the wallet or close the browser)

This data does not leave your device except when you send transactions or sign messages on-chain.

2. Third-party services

ServiceData sentPurpose
PulseChain RPC (rpc.pulsechain.com, pulsechain.publicnode.com)Wallet address, transaction dataBalances, gas, broadcast transactions

These services have their own privacy policies and may log IP addresses.

3. DApp connections

After you approve, connected websites receive your public wallet address. You can revoke access under Settings → Security & Password → Connected sites. Review every sign and transaction request in the wallet popup.

4. What we do not collect

  • No server accounts or registration
  • No analytics or tracking
  • No sale of personal data
  • No cloud key backup

5. Chrome permissions

  • storage — local wallet data and DApp permissions
  • tabs — route DApp provider messages to the correct browser tab
  • host permissions — blockchain RPC and price APIs listed above
  • content script (all URLs) — inject window.ethereum so PulseChain dApps can connect; no page content is read or modified beyond the provider

6. Security

PBKDF2 (310,000 iterations) + AES-GCM encryption, 10-minute auto-lock, disabled eth_sign, and transaction review before approval.

7. Children

Not intended for users under 18.

8. Changes

We may update this policy. The date above reflects the latest version.
